title: Cinder Block Garage Apartment and 1950s Car, 1958 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges showing a mid-century two-story concrete block structure, likely a garage apartment or duplex, constructed during the post-WWII American building boom. The ground floor features two vintage multi-pane garage doors, an external wooden staircase ascends to an upper-level residence, and the front fender of a late-1950s automobile sits parked in the driveway. The right margin of the print bears a lab-stamped processing date of May 1958.
